modules.title: 从登录到过期：会话怎样认出同一个人

example.label: 浏览器登录页和网络请求

steps.label: 登录响应
steps.demo:
浏览器 · 登录页 / Network

欢迎回来

账号 lin@example.com　密码 ••••••••

登录成功 · 服务器保存 session_7

响应头 Set-Cookie: session_id=session_7; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure
steps.caption: 验证通过后，服务端创建或更新会话，并通过 Set-Cookie 让浏览器保存一个会话标识；Cookie 通常不承载完整会话资料。

steps.label: 后续页面请求
steps.demo:
Network · GET /account
请求头Cookie: session_id=session_7
服务端查询找到有效会话
页面结果账户页 · 已登录
steps.caption: 符合 Cookie 的域、路径和浏览器策略时，浏览器才会发送标识；服务端查到仍有效的会话后，页面显示已登录。

steps.label: 会话已过期
steps.demo:
Network · GET /account
请求头Cookie: session_id=session_7
服务端查询会话已过期
页面结果请重新登录
steps.caption: 标识仍可能出现在请求中，但服务端不再接受已过期或撤销的会话，因此要求重新登录；这不等同于密码验证失败。

modules.title: 会话保持登录经过什么

items.title: 登录时服务器创建会话
items.text: 账号密码验证通过后，服务器为这个人创建一段会话状态，并发给浏览器一个标识。

items.title: 符合条件的后续请求带上标识
items.text: 符合 Cookie 的域、路径和浏览器策略时，后续请求会带上标识；服务器查到有效会话后，页面继续显示已登录。

items.title: 过期或清除后失效
items.text: 会话超过有效期，或标识被清除，服务器不再认账，页面就会要求重新登录。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 被要求重新登录不等于密码错误：会话过期是登录状态到期，认证失败是这次身份没被接受。排查时先分清是“状态没了”还是“身份不对”。

lessonPractice.title: 用户反馈“每隔半小时就被要求重新登录”。最可能的原因是什么？

options.label: 会话有效期太短，标识到期后不再被接受
options.feedback: 对。短有效期会让用户频繁重新登录；调整有效期或支持记住登录可以改善。

options.label: 用户的密码记错了，每次都是认证失败
options.feedback: 能登录说明密码是对的；问题是登录状态保持不住。

options.label: 数据库挂了，所有操作都失败
options.feedback: 数据库故障会有更广泛的报错，不只是定时要求重新登录。

en.title: A user reports being asked to sign in again every half hour. What is the most likely cause?

options.label: The session lifetime is too short, so the identifier stops being accepted
options.feedback: Correct. A short lifetime makes users re-sign-in frequently; adjusting the lifetime or supporting remember-me helps.

options.label: The user mistyped the password, so authentication fails each time
options.feedback: Being able to sign in proves the password is right; the issue is that the signed-in state does not persist.

options.label: The database is down, so all operations fail
options.feedback: A database outage causes broader failures, not just periodic re-sign-in prompts.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 用户每隔半小时被要求重新登录。请检查会话的有效期设置，说明当前值是多久；如果确实太短，调整为更合理的时长，并确认调整后连续操作一小时仍保持登录。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Users are asked to sign in again every half hour. Check the session lifetime setting and state its current value; if it is too short, adjust it to a reasonable duration and confirm an hour of continuous use stays signed in.

learning.assumes: You have used sites that require sign-in, or been asked to sign in again.
learning.outcome: When a page asks you to sign in again, you can tell whether the session expired, the cookie was cleared, or authentication itself failed.

modules.title: From sign-in to expiry: how a session recognizes the same person

example.label: A browser sign-in page and its requests

steps.label: Sign-in response
steps.demo:
Browser · Sign-in / Network

Welcome back

Account lin@example.com　Password ••••••••

Signed in · server stores session_7

Response header Set-Cookie: session_id=session_7; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure
steps.caption: After verification, the service creates or updates a session and uses Set-Cookie to store an identifier in the browser. The cookie usually does not contain the full session record.

steps.label: A later page request
steps.demo:
Network · GET /account
Request headerCookie: session_id=session_7
Service lookupValid session found
Page resultAccount page · signed in
steps.caption: The browser sends the identifier only when the cookie domain, path, and browser policies allow it. The service looks up a valid session and returns the signed-in page.

steps.label: Session expired
steps.demo:
Network · GET /account
Request headerCookie: session_id=session_7
Service lookupSession expired
Page resultPlease sign in again
steps.caption: The identifier may still be sent, but the service no longer accepts an expired or revoked session and asks for sign-in again. This is different from password verification failing.

items.title: The server creates a session at sign-in
items.text: After credentials pass, the server creates a session state for this person and gives the browser an identifier.

items.title: Matching requests carry the identifier
items.text: Requests carry it when cookie domain, path, and browser policies match; the service looks up the session to keep the user signed in.

items.title: It fails after expiry or clearing
items.text: When the session expires or the identifier is cleared, the server no longer recognizes it and the page asks for sign-in.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Being asked to sign in again does not mean the password is wrong: session expiry is the signed-in state ending, while authentication failure is the identity not being accepted. Separate state is gone from identity is wrong first.

distinctions.label: Cookie
distinctions.text: A cookie is the technical carrier of the identifier; a session is the state kept server-side. They work together but are not the same thing.

distinctions.label: Token
distinctions.text: A token is a credential the client holds and presents; a session keeps state on the server and matches the identifier each time.
